C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No. 745
Date 3/12/16
Ash
Shanghai Municipal Council.
December 4th 1918

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE JUNCTA）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

Sir,
It is reported that a meeting will be held in
the Palace Hotel at 3 p.m. 4th inst under the auspices
of the Chili Guild to discuss the Laoshikai incident.
It is expected that two delegates from Tientsin
will be present and will explain the whole situation.
Members of the Chamber of Commerce, the Press association
and other local bodies have been invited to attend.
The hotel has been requested to provide seating
accommodation for sixty persons.
As a result of a fire which occurred in the City
at 5 a.m. 2nd inst 6 houses were completely destroyed.
The fire is believed to have been caused accidentally.
A meeting was held in Yu Yuen Garden at 2.30 p.m.
3rd inst under the auspices of the Kiangsi association
to welcome General Li Lih Chun 李烈鈞. One Tsu
Zung Hai 鄒靜齋 presided. Speeches were made
recounting the merits of the General and his work during
the recent revolution. The meeting which was orderly
terminated at 4 p.m. There were about 500 persons present
including five Japanese.
Han Hwe 韓恢 has sent a petition to General Yang
stating that he has organised a labour party and requests
that it be officially recognised. General Yang replied
directing the petitioner to apply to the local police.
It is expected that the remains of General Tsai
Ao will arrive at noon to-day.
The shops in the Settlements and City will
fly their flags at half mast to morrow.

Your Obedient Servant,
WB new man /
Detective Sub Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

刑事调查处
情报官登记
编号 745
日期 1916年12月3日
Ash
上海工部局。
1918年12月4日

（印章：上海工部局警务处联合）
警务处，
（侦探科）

先生，
据报，智利同乡会将于本月4日下午3时在礼查饭店举行会议，讨论老西开事件。
预计将有两名来自天津的代表出席，并解释整个局势。
已邀请商会、报业公会及其他本地团体的成员参加。
已要求饭店提供六十人的座位。
由于本月2日凌晨5时城内发生火灾，六栋房屋被完全烧毁。
据信该火灾系意外引起。
本月3日下午2时30分，在江西同乡会的主持下，于豫园举行会议，欢迎李烈钧将军。由邹静斋主持。会上发表演讲，叙述了该将军的功绩及其在最近革命期间的工作。会议秩序井然，于下午4时结束。约有500人出席，其中包括五名日本人。
韩恢已向杨将军递交请愿书，称其已组织一个劳工党，并请求予以正式承认。杨将军回复，指示请愿者向当地警方申请。
预计蔡锷将军的灵柩将于今日中午抵达。
租界及城内的商铺明日将降半旗致哀。

您顺从的仆人，
WB new man /
侦探副督察。

警察总监上尉。

Form 2    31
Shanghai Municipal Police.
Toubbling Weel    Station.
December 14 th    1916
REPORT ON Meeting at the Yu Yuen Gardens.
Made by. J. L. Sullivan.    Forwarded by.
Sir
I respectfully beg to report that the meeting to welcome
General Lee Lieh Ching (李烈鈞) was held in the Yu Yuen
Gardens on the 3 rd inst.
The meeting started at 2 00 and finished at 3 35 p.m
and was attended by about 600 persons. Most of those
who attended were of the merchant and business men class,
and very few, if any, officials.
From a translation of the speeches made there was
nothing that could be objected to. Lee Lieh Ching exhorted
his listeners to do their best for the government, and
the other speakers confined their attention principally to
praising Lee Lieh Ching.
The list of speakers is as follows:
Lee Lieh Ching    (李 烈 鈞)
Tew Jing Tsa    ( 靜 斋)
Pau Zen Zung    (色 全 顺)
Tia Tze Chung    (謝 子 雲)
Zung Pah Hsuan    (陈 伯 希) newspaper editor
Lee Van Tsing    (李 渭 清) newspaper editor
I beg to remain
Sir
Your Obedient Servant
J. Sullivan. Det. Sergt.
The Chief Detective Inspector.

上海警务处。
Toubbling Weel（原文不清，音译）巡捕房。
1916年12月14日
关于豫园会议的报告。
报告人：J. L. Sullivan。转呈人：
先生
我谨报告，欢迎李烈钧（李烈鈞）将军的会议于本月3日在豫园举行。
会议于下午2时开始，3时35分结束，约有600人出席。出席者大多为商人和商界人士，官员极少，即便有也寥寥无几。
根据对演讲内容的翻译，没有任何可非议之处。李烈钧勉励听众尽力效忠政府，其他发言者则主要致力于赞扬李烈钧。
发言人名单如下：
李烈钧（李 烈 鈞）
Tew Jing Tsa（靜 斋）
Pau Zen Zung（色 全 顺）
Tia Tze Chung（謝 子 雲）
Zung Pah Hsuan（陈 伯 希）报纸编辑
Lee Van Tsing（李 渭 清）报纸编辑
我谨呈
先生
您顺从的仆人
J. Sullivan. 侦探警长。
总侦探督察。

Form 2    34
Shanghai Municipal Police.
Pudding Nee    Station.
December 2nd    1916
REPORT ON    Meeting at the Yu Yuan Gardens
Made by L. A. Sullivan.    Forwarded by Inspector M......
Sir
I respectfully beg to report that a meeting will
be held at the Yu Yuan Gardens at 2 p.m. on the
3rd inst. to welcome one Lee Yok Woo (李協和) alias
Li Lik Chung (李烈鈞)
I understand that Li Lik Chung (李烈鈞)
is a native of Kiangsi, and was formerly a
revolutionary general at Canton.
I beg to remain
Sir
Your Obedient Servant
L. Sullivan Det. Sergt.
Noted X.O
R.H
2/12

1916年12月2日
关于豫园会议的报告
报告人：L. A. Sullivan。由 M...... 督察转呈
先生
我谨报告，将于本月3日下午2时在豫园举行会议，欢迎一位名为李协和（李協和），别名李烈钧（李烈鈞）的人士。
据悉，李烈钧（李烈鈞）是江西人，曾任广州的革命军将军。
我谨呈
先生
您顺从的仆人
L. Sullivan 侦探警长。
备注 X.O
R.H
12月2日
